mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways (GABA potentiation vs dopamine antagonism), and haloperidol may inhibit diazepam metabolism via CYP3A4/2C19, increasing benzodiazepine levels.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and cognitive impairment; reduce diazepam dose if necessary and assess for orthostatic hypotension and extrapyramidal effects.
